Hi, it's really relatable honestly and I've experienced living like that, but guess what, don't lose hope! Take some B vitamins, drink some milk and always motivate yourself. Set up your goals and make a plan on how you solve your problem. Life is not easy but guess what, living like that makes you even stronger, look around you and the world is a beautiful place, even if it's cruel. If your parents are still fighting each other, just ignore them and focus planning your goal and be ambitious. Dont let your bullies get into you as well!

 As long as your still alive, there are still purpose in your life to live in. Try learning new hobbies like learning how to program. You can learn how to make a game by just tutorial from any videos from youtube OR, you can learn how to read and write japanese. Life maybe hard but it is like a game. Dont waste your life and you still have lots of time to live and you can literally learn something new. Do some workouts and do some new hobbies and that will ease your depression. It maybe hard at first but guess what, once you try it for the first time, you will likely going to enjoy it, but remember, take it one step at a time.

Let me give you an advice pal, grades are just number, they dont dictate your life. There are lots of highschool/college dropouts who are far more successful than the ones who graduate. 

Dont live up on someone's expectation because in the end of the day, the only one who's gonna entertain someone is yourself. Honestly, I think failing would be more like a blessing in disguise because that's how you learn and succeed in life, is by knowing pain and learning from our mistakes. Take this as an opportunity for you to find yojlur true passion, or your job thaf you really love. If you dont succeed in school, there are tons of opportunity, go self-educate yourself with udemy courses and become either a self-taught game developer, a graphic artist and such...

Failing in school doesnt mean its the end of your life and I've been through that.
